question: How can an entire place be brought under subjugation through ritual gestures?
premises: Gestures beginning with añjali are used.
They are joined in proper order.
The entire place becomes subject to subjugation.
inference: By sequentially joining gestures beginning with añjali, one makes the entire place subject to subjugation.
plain_english: Having joined añjali and so on in order, one makes the entire place subject to subjugation.
